title: Cassidy Loses Senate Primary in Louisiana, as Trump Vanquishes G.O.P. Foe
description: Senator Bill Cassidy, a two-term Republican who voted to convict President Trump in his 2021 impeachment trial, could not muster enough votes to continue to a runoff next month.

title: UFC star Conor McGregor returning to the cage for first time in 5 years in July
description: MMA superstar Conor McGregor will return to the octagon for the first time since 2021 to face Max Holloway on July 11 in Las Vegas, UFC President Dana White announced Saturday.

title: GOP Sen. Bill Cassidy speaks after Louisiana primary loss
description: Republican Senator Bill Cassidy spoke out after losing the Louisiana primary as Rep. Julia Letlow and state Treasurer John Fleming advance to a runoff. Cassidy spoke about democracy during his concession speak, stressing that he was not “claiming the election was stolen” after a loss.

title: A "Survivor" finalist's mission to prove his late sister was murdered
description: "Survivor" 48 and 50 contestant Joe Hunter believes his sister Joanna, whose death was ruled a suicide, was murdered. He and their mother are working to be Joanna's voice and advocate for others who have experienced domestic violence.

title: Joe Hunter's Mission
description: A "Survivor" contestant believes his sister was murdered and is determined to be her voice. "48 Hours" correspondent Natalie Morales reports.
